name: Triangulate [Teamwork]
body:
Your distrust of magic has forced you to develop tactics to fight witches, fey, and other supernatural foes. No matter how clever they think they are, they can’t hide.

Prerequisite(s): Blind-Fight, Greater Blind-Fight, Improved Blind-Fight, Perception 15 ranks, human.

Benefit(s): Whenever both you and an ally are within 30 feet of an invisible foe of whose presence you’re aware, you automatically pinpoint the foe’s location for you and said ally. Whenever both you and an ally are within 30 feet of a creature and your ally misses that creature because of its concealment, they can reroll their miss chance percentile roll.
